title: Portable Binary File Format
requirements: Design a save-game format: magic number, version, little-endian fields, length-prefixed strings, CRC-32 checksum
Reader/writer using `std::bit_cast`, `std::byteswap`, `std::span<std::byte>` — no UB, no `reinterpret_cast` punning
Version migration (v1 files load in v2 code)
Fuzz the reader with libFuzzer + ASan; it must never crash on garbage
